title: 生菜需求回暖，室内农业龙头谈扩张与食品安全
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Have you seen an effect on your business when it comes to all of these fears of outbreaks and people maybe eating less greens?
segments.zh: 您是否看到这些疫情担忧对您的业务产生了影响，人们可能少吃绿叶蔬菜？

segments.en: Well, I think we're certainly saying that that people are eating a little bit less greens as they sort of process the information that's been happening and as it gets
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为我们确实看到人们吃绿叶蔬菜少了一些，因为他们正在消化这些信息，而且随着信息传播，

segments.en: pushed up into the news cycle through things like Taylor Farms announcement today that that doesn't help. But you know at the end of
segments.zh: 像泰勒农场今天的公告这样的新闻进入新闻周期，这没有帮助。但你知道，最终

segments.en: the day I think that consumers want to eat salads and they're starting to start to eat them more than they were just a few weeks ago at the beginning of the outbreak. I did tell David that I am just fearless or maybe a responsible
segments.zh: 我认为消费者想吃沙拉，他们开始比疫情初期几周吃得更多。我告诉大卫，我无所畏惧，或者也许是个负责任的人，

segments.en: and I still do. Or it's the salad fan. Yeah, it's summer.
segments.zh: 我仍然这样做。或者是个沙拉爱好者。是的，现在是夏天。

segments.en: But I want to talk about your business because you've gone from one rooftop greenhouse in Brooklyn to more than 40 acres nationwide. What to you is the biggest unlock to maybe making indoor farming at scale work.
segments.zh: 但我想谈谈您的业务，因为您从布鲁克林的一个屋顶温室发展到全国超过40英亩。对您来说，让室内农业规模化运作的最大解锁点是什么？

segments.en: So we have now have 12 greenhouses around the country now.
segments.zh: 我们现在在全国有12个温室。

segments.en: Nine different states and that's actually part of the unlock to make indoor controlled environment agriculture work is to be close to the locations where consumers are shopping.
segments.zh: 九个不同的州，这实际上是让室内受控环境农业运作的解锁点之一，即靠近消费者购物的地方。

segments.en: You know that's one of the benefits of indoor greenhouse growing is that it doesn't travel thousands of miles to to get to consumers doors.
segments.zh: 你知道，室内温室种植的好处之一是它不需要运输数千英里才能到达消费者家门口。

segments.en: And we that gives a fresher product more beautiful product and something that we're really excited about. And I think it will play a role
segments.zh: 这给我们带来了更新鲜、更美观的产品，我们对此感到非常兴奋。我认为这将发挥作用。

segments.en: in this nation's food security and food availability over time.
segments.zh: 这关系到国家长期的食品安全和供应。
